name: XJ-13
summary: **XJ-13** is a [[kind:cut|clone-only]] cultivar that emerged in Orange County, [[country:US|California]]'s medical dispensary scene in the late 2000s, credited informally to the Orange County Patients Collective. It is usually described as a cross of [[jack-herer]] and [[g13-haze|G13 Haze]], though some sources give G13 without the Haze line. THC Design's 2009 acquisition of the clone helped spread it through Northern California.
